message:
This reference only captures the initial value of `value`. Did you mean to reference it inside a closure instead?
https://svelte.dev/e/state_referenced_locally
`` element should have an alt attribute https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_missing_attribute

Buttons and links should either contain text or have an `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or `title` attribute
https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_consider_explicit_label

`<a>` element should have an href attribute
https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_missing_attribute

'' is not a valid href attribute
https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_invalid_attribute
